title: Leap seconds added to UTC vs. removed, 1972-2016

source.name: Historical list of leap seconds
source.publisher: International Earth Rotation and Reference Systems Service (IERS), via timeanddate.com

notes: 27 positive leap seconds have been added to UTC since the first in June 1972, most recently on December 31 2016; none have ever been removed, because a negative leap second has never yet been needed -- until the recent rotation speed-up made one a live possibility for the first time (see negative_leap_second_odds).
